text_block_list.text:
One day.
As I happened to pass in front of an arcade――

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*...

An unexpected face was engrossed in a rhythm dancing game.
Though moving with fierce concentration...
the timing was completely off with every single beat.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *pant*... What should I do...?

I couldn't take my eyes off her unexpected appearance,
and suddenly, our eyes met.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
........
First, I need you to hear me out.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
, I take pride in being able to do anything
better than the average person. However――

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
There is only one area in which I struggle.
Athletics.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I finished dead last in the marathon, never managed to catch
a single ball, and even had to take retests for the vaulting box.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
With straight A's in all other subjects, PE was always a D...
Even now, drowsiness hits me the instant I get home from going out.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Even so, a baseline level of physical fitness is indispensable when guiding Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: In fact, I was asked to provide dance lessons just the other day.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: However, I cannot dance, nor do I have the time to attend lessons. Therefore—
With an imposing stance, she pointed at the screen, which displayed "0 Combo."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I was utilizing my spare time to practice
my dancing using this machine.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
However, this proved surprisingly difficult...
...*sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Should I buy more reference books...? But
my bookshelves are already bursting at the seams...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
As I feared, is this not suited for me...?
There must be some other method...
It's rare to see someone as capable as her at such a total loss. Is there any way I can help...?
choice_data_list: How about building up your stamina first?
Let's keep trying as many times as it takes!
I'm in a hurry today, so……

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed, that is essential for sustaining performance. It was a complete blind spot.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: If that is the case, we will need to relocate.

Curious about what would happen next,
I followed after her――

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: First, ten round trips... No, make it five!

Her leisurely jogging continued endlessly
until the evening.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... *pant*...
I-I can't... anymore...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much for your cheers.
It served as great motivation.
choice_data_list: No, I just couldn't help it.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing fancy, but please let me treat you to some ramen today.
Afterward, we headed into a ramen shop――

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: It has been years since I last went running, but it is remarkably refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though I've come to understand
a little bit of the view Umamusume see.
We talked about all sorts of things together.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to train here...
but the weather seems to be turning a bit suspicious.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
We cannot afford to catch a cold.
Let us call it off for today...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, that is true.
Nothing of worth can ever be attained without effort.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Complaints can wait; right now, all I can do is strive forward...!
(Cha-cha-cha cha cha♪)

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Huff, haah... I see. So if I raise my right leg as I jump...
(Cha-cha-cha cha cha♪)

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's how it goes.
Right, right, left, turn... Alright.
Thanks to her hard work, she seemed to gradually get the hang of it. And several hours later...
(Cha-cha-cha chaaan♪)

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: All right...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my apologies... I didn't mean to cause a commotion.
...Ahem.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I believe I've grown quite a bit. I'm glad I didn't give up.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much for your kind words of encouragement.
If you'd like, please let me treat you to a drink.

Afterward, we went to a nearby izakaya,
where they treated me before I headed home.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Even as Trainers, I believe every single one of us
should at least be able to dance to the debut song.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps dance training should indeed be integrated
into the Trainer curriculum... Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I see.
My apologies for stopping you.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll see you back at Tracen Academy.
